newsitem.title: NIGERIA: SOCCER-NIGERIA NAME SQUAD OF EXILES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIA NAME SQUAD OF EXILES.

text.p: Nigeria coach Phillipe Troussier has named an entirely overseas-based squad of 20 for the country's final World Cup qualifier against Guinea in Conakry next Sunday.
Although Nigeria have already reached the finals, Frenchman Troussier said he named experienced players because he wanted to achieve a good record in the qualifiers.

He has called up 1994 World Cup goalkeeper Peter Rufai, defenders Abiodun Obafemi and Patrick Paschal and midfielders James Obiorah, Karibe Ojigwe and Ogechukwu Agali. The remaining 14 have been squad regulars in Nigeria's unbeaten qualifying campaign.

"I invited the new faces because Sunday Oliseh, Tijjani Babangida, Celestine Babayaro and Wilson Oruma will be busy with club commitments," Troussier said. "I also want to give a chance to some new players."
Goalkeepers: Peter Rufai (Hercules), Willy Okpara (Orlando Pirates), Abiodun Baruwa (Sion).
Defenders: Austin Eguavoen (Torpedo Moscow), Uche Okechukwu (Fenerbahce), Mobi Oparaku (Turnhout), Taribo West (Inter), Abiodun Obafemi (Lens), Patrick Paschal (Genclerbirligi).
Midfielders: Austin Okocha (Fenerbahce), James Obiora (Anderlecht), Mutiu Adepoju (Real Sociedad), Karibe Ojigwe (Kaiserslautern), Garba Lawal (Utrecht), Ogechukwu Agali (Marseille).
Forwards: Daniel Amokachi (Besiktas), Emmanuel Amunike (Barcelona), Finidi George (Real Betis), Chris Ohenhen (Compostella), Jonathan Akpoborie (Stuttgart).
